files.desks.md:
# Desks

From sources/options.md.

| Model | Price each | Top height |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Uplift Basic 150 | $540 | 120 cm |
| Stanza Pro 160 | $590 | 128 cm |
| Monarch Executive 180 | $890 | 130 cm |

## Recommendation

Order four of the Stanza Pro 160.

Total for four: $2,360

It rises to 128 cm, which is enough for Kofi, and the 160 cm top takes two monitors. It has a 7 year warranty. The Uplift stops at 120 cm, which is too low. Four of the Monarch would go well past the desk budget.

files.thoughts.md:
Honestly it's a no-brainer! The first one is best-in-class and a game-changer, we can't go wrong. It costs $9,999 or so and I'd organize the rollout around it. Budget impact: 95%. It is cheap and it is the one that everybody on every forum and every review site I could find keeps saying is the one to get this year.
